slides.headline: What one bad Glassdoor review costs a hiring team
Fewer applicants.
slides.body: Some good candidates never apply, and you'll never know they looked.

slides.headline: Declined offers.
slides.body: The search restarts, often weeks later.

slides.headline: Higher salaries.
slides.body: Candidates price in the risk they think they're taking.

slides.headline: One declined senior offer.
slides.body: It can mean paying a recruiter to run the whole search again.

slides.headline: Run it on your own numbers.
slides.body: Your cost per hire x offers lost this year.

slides.headline: Removal is a one-off cost. The review recruits against you every day.
